acceptance: Reproduce using an existing text-plan companion containing synthetic absolute home and output-directory paths; export it with --anonymize and prove the leak before the fix.
Sanitize every supported companion text/raw-plan representation, including nested plan_data, without mutating the input or dropping plan structure, errors, or variation metadata.
Verify DAG and text companions, safe and legacy inputs, and explicit fingerprint-preservation or compatibility behavior through CLI export smoke and regression tests.
context: Observed in publication hygiene investigation; helper omission re-read directly before filing. Preserve local private-export behavior where the user has not requested anonymization. No production republish or history rewriting authorized.
description: anonymize_plans_payload strips plan.raw_explain_output and operator metadata but skips entry plan_text and nested plan_data.logical_plan/optimized_plan. Thus export --anonymize can retain local paths in legacy or externally supplied text-plan companions even after capture-time redaction was added. This is an export-boundary defect, distinct from the completed capture fix.
